info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Grunerit Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the submission of detailed information related to the Grunerit Recliner for catalog purposes. It supports businesses in managing and updating their product details, ensuring accurate representation in product listings. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that seek to enrich their product database. By utilizing this API, businesses can efficiently enhance their catalog offerings, promoting better customer engagement and informed purchasing decisions.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create new details for Grunerit Recliners. It accepts the necessary information in the request body to generate specific details for the recliner model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for creating or updating a Grunerit Recliner. It should contain all necessary parameters as specified in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, with the details of the recliner returned.
